colorBinding.stageNote: Per-channel storage-to-theme resolution exactly as the draw operation resolves cells: default -> theme default, palette index -> ANSI palette entry, literal -> stored ARGB; opaque alpha. Captured with the cells and theme under one buffer read lock. Precedes the inverse-cell swap, minimum-contrast adjustment, opacity compositing and glyph rasterisation, so rendered glyph appearance may still differ from these values.
